items.title: AISA chief Neha Bora released from preventive detention
items.summary: All India Students' Association president Neha Bora was released early Saturday morning after completing formalities under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act, Delhi Police said (via PTI). She was detained at Mandi House on Friday evening en route to the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march. In her first statement after release she alleged protesters are detained without valid reason and held for hours, questioned overnight detentions of women ('ought to be released after sunset'), said lawyers were denied access to her for hours, and demanded Abhijeet Dipke's immediate release plus Gyanesh Kumar's impeachment and a halt to SIR.

items.event_time_ist: ~5:00 PM IST, Oct 16 (detention); SEM production scheduled later today, Oct 17
items.title: Abhijeet Dipke under BNSS preventive arrest; to be produced before SEM court today
items.summary: Delhi Police placed CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke under preventive arrest (action under BNSS Sections 126 and 170, breach of peace) after detaining him Friday evening ahead of the 'Lehra Do Tiranga' march at Connaught Place. Police will produce him before the Special Executive Magistrate (SEM) court — the same court that granted him conditional bail on Oct 10 — later today. CJP legal head Ratna Singh alleged Dipke's location remains unknown to his team and lawyers have not been allowed to meet him; Zee24Taas/Saam TV clips show CJP supporters asking 'Where have you kept Abhijeet Dipke?' outside police stations.
